${mod_id}.name: ${mod_name}
${mod_id}.editor.title: ${mod_name} — Editor
${mod_id}.editor.hint.no_world: Join a world to see the preview.
${mod_id}.editor.hint.drag:
Drag: turn.
Wheel: zoom.
Right-click: reset the view.
${mod_id}.editor.add_item.tooltip:
Pick an item from your inventory.
If an entry already covers it, that entry opens.
${mod_id}.editor.picker.cancel.tooltip: Back to the entry list without adding anything.
${mod_id}.editor.add_empty.tooltip: Add a blank entry and type the item id by hand.
${mod_id}.editor.pose.tooltip: Pose of the preview model: standing or sneaking.
${mod_id}.editor.subject: Skin
${mod_id}.editor.subject.tooltip: Whose model the preview uses. Steve and Alex are the vanilla wide and slim defaults.
${mod_id}.editor.cape.tooltip: Show the cape in the preview. Only does anything if that player has one.
${mod_id}.editor.settings.tooltip: Settings about the mod rather than one item. Saved from this screen too.
${mod_id}.settings.title: Mod settings
${mod_id}.editor.mod_enabled.tooltip: Turns the mod on and off. Off means nothing is shown on anyone.
${mod_id}.editor.under_cape.tooltip: Draw the item under the cape rather than over it.
${mod_id}.editor.under_elytra.tooltip: Draw the item under the elytra rather than over it.
${mod_id}.editor.item_id.tooltip: Item id this entry applies to.
${mod_id}.editor.apply_to_similar.toolti: ON: use this config for every item of the same type - all swords, all axes, modded included.
${mod_id}.editor.match_name.tooltip:
Match only items renamed exactly like this one.
None ticked = any variant of the item.
${mod_id}.editor.match_model_data.toolti:
Match only items with the same custom_model_data.
None ticked = any variant of the item.
${mod_id}.editor.match_item_model.toolti:
Match only items with the same item_model.
None ticked = any variant of the item.
${mod_id}.editor.enabled.tooltip: Show this item on the back.
${mod_id}.editor.flip.tooltip: Turn the item to face the other way. On by default for shields, tridents and spears; a flat sprite looks the same either way.
${mod_id}.editor.display.tooltip: Display context the item model is rendered with.
${mod_id}.editor.off_x.tooltip:
Offset along X: + right, - left.
Scroll: ±0.01.
${mod_id}.editor.off_y.tooltip:
Offset along Y: + up, - down.
Scroll: ±0.01.
${mod_id}.editor.off_z.tooltip:
Offset along Z: + away from the back, - into it.
Scroll: ±0.01.
${mod_id}.editor.reset_all.tooltip: Back to the built-in defaults for this item, ignoring what is saved. Id, components and filters are kept.
${mod_id}.editor.share.needs_save: Save first - a profile is what the config says.
${mod_id}.editor.no_world.body: The editor needs a world: the player model and the world registries.
${mod_id}.editor.share.tooltip: Copy this entry as one line. Players with the mod see it in chat as a [TOMB | Import] chip.
${mod_id}.editor.paste.tooltip: Paste a profile (Ctrl+V), a whole sentence works. The row then asks what to do with it.
${mod_id}.editor.paste.invalid: That text holds no TOMB profile
${mod_id}.editor.paste.as_entry.tooltip: Take the whole profile: item, components and look. If an entry already covers that item, it is written into that one.
${mod_id}.editor.paste.settings_only.too: Take only the look from the profile - display, flip, scale, rotation, position - into the selected entry. Its item and filters stay.
${mod_id}.editor.paste.settings_only.no_: No entry is selected, so there is nothing to write the settings into.
${mod_id}.editor.paste.applied: Display settings applied to the selected entry
${mod_id}.chat.invalid: That profile could not be read
${mod_id}.editor.share.copied_long: Copied, but it is %s characters and chat holds %s - it will be cut off there.
${mod_id}.editor.paste.added: Profile added as a new entry
${mod_id}.editor.paste.merged: Profile applied to the entry that already covers this item.
${mod_id}.chat.chip.unknown: No such item is registered here
${mod_id}.editor.save.tooltip: Write the changes and stay here. Turns into Done once nothing is left to save.
Click again to drop everything since the last save.
${mod_id}.editor.cancel_changes.instant:
Right-click: no confirming.
Clicking elsewhere calls it off.
${mod_id}.editor.cancel_changes.tooltip:
Put every entry back to what is on disk. Entries added since the last save go with it.
Esc closes the editor; this does not.
${mod_id}.editor.cancel_changes.done: Everything back to the last saved state
${mod_id}.editor.done.tooltip: Everything is saved - close and go back.
